title: Unlocking Multilingual Reasoning Capabilities of LLMs and LVLMs via Representation Engineering

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating reasoning performance (accuracy) and input-output language consistency on mathematical and general reasoning benchmarks (e.g., MGSM, MSVAMP, MMathVerse, MMathVista) translated into 8 different languages. The paper measures the performance disparity between high-resource languages (English) and low-resource languages, visualizes latent space distribution shifts toward English using t-SNE and KDE, and evaluates the effectiveness of 'latent english debiasing vectors' to mitigate English bias during the understanding forward passing stage.
